scripts.test: npm --prefix shared test && npm --prefix collector test && npm --prefix app test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix shared run lint && npm --prefix collector run lint && npm --prefix app run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix shared run typecheck && npm --prefix collector run typecheck && npm --prefix app run typecheck
scripts.build:web: cross-env USERPROFILE=./.tmp_home HOME=./.tmp_home CI=1 EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 npm --prefix app run build:web
scripts.doctor: cross-env USERPROFILE=./.tmp_home HOME=./.tmp_home CI=1 EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 npm --prefix app run doctor
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run scan:secrets
